title: gw Configuration
description: Configuration file for the gw CLI tool (.gw/config.json). Manages git worktree workflows including auto-copy, hooks, cleanup, and update strategies.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for IDE autocompletion and validation.

configVersion.description: Config schema version for migrations. Managed automatically by gw — do not edit manually.

defaultBranch.description: Default source worktree name used for file copying (auto-copy/sync) and as the base for new branches. This worktree is protected from auto-clean.

autoCopyFiles.description: Files and directories to automatically copy from the default branch worktree when creating new worktrees with 'gw checkout'. Paths are relative to the worktree root. Directories should end with '/' to copy recursively. Non-existent files are skipped with a warning.

items.description: File or directory path relative to the worktree root.

hooks.description: Command hooks that run before/after gw operations. Hook commands support variable substitution: {worktree}, {worktreePath}, {gitRoot}, {branch}.

checkout.description: Hooks for the 'gw checkout' command (creating new worktrees).

pre.description: Commands to run before creating the worktree. If any command fails, the checkout is aborted.

items.description: Shell command to execute. Supports variables: {worktree}, {worktreePath}, {gitRoot}, {branch}.

post.description: Commands to run after the worktree is created successfully. Failures produce warnings but don't roll back the worktree.

items.description: Shell command to execute. Supports variables: {worktree}, {worktreePath}, {gitRoot}, {branch}.

cleanThreshold.description: Number of days before worktrees are considered stale and eligible for cleanup. Used by 'gw clean' and auto-clean.

autoClean.description: When enabled, gw will prompt to clean stale worktrees after certain commands (checkout, list). Prompts at most once every 24 hours. Uses cleanThreshold for age check. Never removes the defaultBranch worktree.

updateStrategy.description: Default strategy for 'gw update' when syncing worktrees with the latest changes from the default branch. Can be overridden per-command with --merge or --rebase flags.

prResolvers.description: Ordered list of resolvers tried by 'gw pr' to translate a user-supplied identifier (PR number, GitHub URL, Linear review URL, etc.) into PR metadata. When omitted, gw uses the default [{ name: 'gh', builtin: 'github' }]. When set, fully replaces the default — include the github builtin explicitly to keep PR-number and github.com URL support. Each resolver receives the identifier on stdin and as $1; writes a JSON object to stdout on exit 0 ({prNumber, branch?, owner?, repo?, isCrossRepository?, remote?}); exit non-zero / empty output passes control to the next resolver.

name.description: Human-readable label shown in logs and errors.

command.description: Shell command. Passed to `sh -c`; the identifier is provided on stdin AND as $1 (never spliced into the command string, so input is shell-safe). Mutually exclusive with 'builtin'.

builtin.description: Use a built-in resolver. 'github' uses the gh CLI and returns full PR metadata, avoiding a second metadata round-trip. Mutually exclusive with 'command'.

timeoutMs.description: Per-resolver timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 20000 (20s).
